About this site

## PySpark Example

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("AboutPage").master("local[*]").getOrCreate()

data = [("Sae Hee", "Data Analytics", 2026), ("Alex", "Cloud Computing", 2025)]
df = spark.createDataFrame(data, ["name", "focus_area", "year"])
df.show()
```
